<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <Version>1.2.0</Version>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <Deterministic>true</Deterministic>
    <Description>Offline-catalog, on-device hierarchical latency geolocation with explainable tunnel assessment.</Description>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <EnableNETAnalyzers>true</EnableNETAnalyzers>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="Cli/**/*.cs;tests/**/*.cs" />
    <EmbeddedResource Include="Data/*.bin;Data/*.gz;Data/*.json;Data/*.txt" LogicalName="GeoData.%(Filename)%(Extension)" WithCulture="false" />
    <None Update="README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="/" />
    <None Update="Data/NOTICE.txt" Pack="true" PackagePath="/" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <Target Name="RequireBundledMeasurementsCatalog" BeforeTargets="BeforeBuild">
    <Error Condition="!Exists('$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/Data/anchors.json.gz') Or !Exists('$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/Data/localities.bin')"
      Text="Missing bundled catalog. Run tools/build_catalogs.py using the bundled seed snapshot or a downloaded release snapshot." />
  </Target>
</Project>
